citations.text: The headword is 愛(爱), read ài. The entry describes 愛 as developed from 㤅, quotes 說文 as 愛，行皃。从夂，㤅聲, and separately quotes 㤅，惠也。从心，旡聲. It reports a Guodian 老子甲 example “甚㤅(爱)必大費” and a Zhongshan 方壺 inscription, among later uses. These are the book’s reports, not independent readings of the cited artifacts or a precise date for when 愛 acquired affection-related use. The scan reads 皃 after 行, not 兒.
